config.label: Label for this instance, e
config.description: Label for this instance, e.g. backend or frontend. Appears in message tags so the other side knows who is talking.

config.label: Address of the other machine as host:port
config.description: Address of the other machine as host:port. A Tailscale address is recommended over a public one.

config.label: Shared secret authenticating messages between the two instances
config.description: Shared secret authenticating messages between the two instances. Must match on both sides. There is no default: without it the intercom starts unpaired, binds no port, and refuses to send.

config.label: Port to listen on for incoming messages
config.description: Port to listen on for incoming messages. Defaults to 8788.

config.label: Interface to bind the listener to
config.description: Interface to bind the listener to. Defaults to 0.0.0.0. Set 127.0.0.1 when a tunnel fronts the intercom, so only the tunnel can connect.

config.label: How long an outbound POST may hang before giving up
config.description: How long an outbound POST may hang before giving up. Defaults to 10000.
